replacements.value:
Hi Lee,

I know you're busy, and I want to be clear: I haven't heard back yet, and that's completely fine — silence isn't a no, and I'm not assuming anything.

I just need your decision by 16:00 today so I can move forward on my end. If you need a little more time or want to talk it through, let me know and I'll do my best to adapt.

No pressure beyond the deadline itself. Thanks so much, and I appreciate you taking a look when you can.

Warmly,
Your name
